name: Custom orthotics and insoles
summary: How expats get custom foot orthotics in Singapore for plantar fasciitis, knee load issues, and standing-desk days — clinical casting vs retail heat-mould inserts.
body:
Custom orthotics reshape load through the foot. Podiatrists and some sports-med clinics prescribe them after exam and sometimes gait review; pharmacies sell generic cushions that help mild cases but are not the same device.

## When custom makes sense
- Plantar fasciitis persisting after basic load management
- Posterior tibial tendon or midfoot pain
- Knee tracking issues with clear foot contribution
- Standing-heavy jobs on hard mall/office floors
- Selected paediatric flat-foot pathways under clinician advice

Shoe volume matters — narrow dress shoes may not fit bulky posts.

## Process
Assessment, casting or scan, manufacture lead time, and dispense review. Expect break-in schedules. Rechecks matter after weight change or new running shoes. Insurance coverage for devices is inconsistent — get written quotes.

## How to choose
Prefer clinicians who explain goals (reduce tissue load) rather than selling annual “posture packages.” Ask about remake policies if the first pair hotspots. Bring your most-worn work and sport shoes to the dispense visit.

## Practical tip
Wear the orthotics with the socks and shoes you actually use at work. A perfect lab fit in running shoes can fail in leather loafers the next morning.
